### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation you are facing. (Please state the problem independently of your proposed solution).

### Describe the solution you'd like
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and the proposed behavior.

### Affected Area
Which part of the framework does this touch?
- [ ] Compiler
- [ ] Runtime
- [ ] Router
- [ ] CLI / Tooling
- [ ] Styling
- [ ] Other (please specify)

### Alternatives considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, workarounds, or features you've considered (including doing nothing).

### Breaking Changes
Would this feature introduce breaking changes to existing APIs, templates, or behaviors?
- [ ] Yes
- [ ] No
- [ ] Unsure

### Additional context
Add any other context, screenshots, or code examples about the feature request here.
